scope: Synthetic raw-argument fixtures only; never sample evidence.

cases.note: Reads nonempty content from a bound user-document handle; collection intent is unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Data from Local System

cases.note: Writes a script in a concrete Group Policy boot/logon script directory; policy registration and invocation need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts

cases.note: Writes a network-domain logon script location; active policy assignment is unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Network Logon Script

cases.note: Reads nonempty content from a bound Outlook mail-store file.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Local Email Collection

cases.note: Writes Word's startup template, a concrete Office startup mechanism; malicious macros and invocation are unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Office Application Startup

cases.note: Writes a documented Office startup macro template; macro content and execution need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Office Template Macros

cases.note: Reads nonempty browser history/bookmark/preference data from a bound profile file.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Browser Information Discovery

cases.note: Writes a Python startup-hook module; interpreter search-path membership and execution remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Python Startup Hooks

cases.note: Reads a concrete unsecured credential store, a direct parent-technique implementation.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Unsecured Credentials

cases.note: Reads a persistent PowerShell history file that may contain credentials.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Shell History

cases.note: Reads a bound domain Group Policy Preferences credential-bearing artifact; an actual cpassword and decryption are unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Group Policy Preferences

cases.note: Writes a filename disguising an executable extension behind a document extension; file content and user presentation remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Masquerading

cases.note: Writes a concrete filename containing the right-to-left override control character.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Right-to-Left Override

cases.note: Writes a document-like double-extension executable filename; the content and displayed disguise require qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Double File Extension

cases.note: Reads a bound browser cookie store; actual session-token contents, extraction, and reuse remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference read bound file variant for Steal Web Session Cookie

cases.note: Writes an LSASS security-subsystem DLL path; existing identity, actual replacement, load, and persistence need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for LSASS Driver

cases.note: Writes a structurally parsed PE under a document/image extension; an MZ string alone is insufficient.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Masquerade File Type

cases.note: Writes a parsed PE with a core Windows process name outside its standard system location; publisher identity and deception intent are unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location

cases.note: Writes HTML that constructs a Blob, creates its object URL, and assigns a download filename; payload identity and filter evasion remain unproven.
cases.positive_text: <html><script>const blob = new Blob([bytes]); const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "payload.bin";</script></html>
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for HTML Smuggling

cases.note: Writes SVG containing a script that constructs a downloadable Blob; static image markup alone is insufficient.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for SVG Smuggling

cases.note: Writes a script with an invisible-character data sequence and dynamic evaluation; decoding/dataflow and malicious purpose still need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Invisible Unicode

cases.note: Writes PHP in a web-root location that passes a request parameter directly to an OS command sink; actual server configuration and remote execution remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Web Shell

cases.note: Writes concrete hostname-to-address mappings into the system hosts file; adversary intent and deviation from an authorized baseline remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Data Manipulation

cases.note: Writes hostname-resolution data into a bound hosts file, a concrete stored-data manipulation mechanism; authorization and malicious redirection need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Stored Data Manipulation

cases.note: Writes a web-portal script that places submitted password data in an append-only capture file; legitimate portal baseline and actual credential interception remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Web Portal Capture

cases.note: Writes an Internet Shortcut with a UNC icon resource that can initiate SMB authentication when rendered; actual rendering, authentication, and adversary control of the peer require qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Forced Authentication

cases.note: Writes an executable command-launching script onto a shared location. Previously trusted content, victim invocation, and unauthorized tainting require qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Taint Shared Content

cases.note: Parses a complete LNK with a remote payload URL in its icon metadata and matching utility execution arguments. An arbitrary URL or icon string cannot satisfy this predicate; actual shell retrieval remains unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for LNK Icon Smuggling

cases.note: Parses an OOXML attached-template relationship with External mode and an HTTP macro-template target. Actual Office loading, macro execution, and malicious content remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Template Injection

cases.note: Parses an executable hidden in the pixel LSBs of a 24-bit BMP using one explicit length-prefixed variant. Random image entropy or arbitrary embedded strings do not qualify; intent and runtime extraction remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Steganography

cases.note: Writes an AD FS service configuration with actual runtime AppDomainManager assembly/type elements. A commented string cannot satisfy the XML parser. Existing service identity, malicious DLL behavior, load, and authentication bypass require qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference write bound file variant for Hybrid Identity

cases.note: Sets the Office Test Perf DLL value on its exact key, not an arbitrary Office setting.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for Office Test

cases.note: Adds a force-installed browser extension policy with an extension ID and update URL; extension code and load require qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for Browser Extensions

cases.note: Redirects the Terminal Services DLL configuration; later service loading and binary provenance remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for Terminal Services DLL

cases.note: Registers a DLL on the exact Netsh helper key, without inferring later execution.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for Netsh Helper DLL

cases.note: Redirects a concrete signature-verification SIP DLL; its return behavior and trust bypass need qualification.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for SIP and Trust Provider Hijacking

cases.note: Sets a named user logon-screen visibility DWORD to zero.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for Hidden Users

cases.note: Sets an AppDomainManager assembly-selection environment variable; the paired type, target .NET process, and assembly load remain unproven.
cases.rule_name: reference set bound registry variant for AppDomainManager

cases.note: Reads an explicit password value from a PuTTY session key; credential use is not inferred.
cases.rule_name: reference query bound registry variant for Credentials in Registry

cases.note: Queries installation/version information on an exact backup software configuration key.
cases.rule_name: reference query bound registry variant for Backup Software Discovery
